# Synthetic OCR fixtures

Generated by [`scripts/gen_fixtures.py`](../../../scripts/gen_fixtures.py) — do not edit by hand.

```bash
python3 scripts/gen_fixtures.py --out tests/fixtures/synth     # regenerate (seed 20261102)
python3 scripts/gen_fixtures.py --check tests/fixtures/synth   # verify byte-exact
python3 scripts/gen_fixtures.py --out /tmp/synth --set large   # 50-page set for accuracy runs
```

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `<name>.png` | 8-bit grayscale, 300 DPI, black text on white (inverted variant: white on black) |
| `<name>.gt.txt` | exact text, one line per rendered line, printable ASCII only |
| `manifest.tsv` | `name, font, size_pt, variant, angle_deg, lines` |

Variants: `clean`, `skew` (`angle_deg` is PIL's `rotate()` angle, counter-clockwise on screen —
the pipeline reports the opposite sign), `noise` (Gaussian, σ = 25), `inverted`. `line_*`
fixtures are single lines (pangrams with digits and punctuation) for recognizer tests.

Text is random sentences from a built-in common-word vocabulary (no third-party text).
Output depends on the font files (DejaVu, Liberation from `/usr/share/fonts/truetype`); the
`Scripts.GenFixtures` ctest skips if they are missing and fails if the committed set is stale.
